text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the ultimate battle of sisters is Biwa Hayahide!
It's Biwa Hayahideee—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Me, against Brian...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You really are fast.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Choosing this race was the right call.
I got to see you at your absolute strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Chasing after your back
reminded me of the old days. Back when we used to run together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I just want to overtake what's right in front of me.
It's not pain or thirst,
just purely—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Ha-ya-hide! Ha-ya-hide!
Ha-ya-hide!! Ha-ya-hide!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Guess we can't really talk like this.
Catch you later, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Brian.
To you, who am I right now—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Was I able to become a big sister you can be proud of...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —You've been my proud big sis since way back when.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, the long-awaited showdown between sisters finally came to pass.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the formula for victory... beyond the equals sign,
Biwa Hayahide's triumph truly awaited.
